sloka: इति मामब्रवीत्सीता कृशाङ्गी धर्मचारिणी ।रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा मृगीवोत्फुल्ललोचना ।। ५.६५.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: iti māmabravītsītā kṛśāṅgī dharmacāriṇī ।rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā mṛgīvotphullalocanā ।। 5.65.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "With her limbs emaciated through austerities detained in Ravana's inner palace, eyes wide open in fear, Sita said this to me:
